title: Hawlgalkii Magaalada Qadiimiga ah
intro: Magaalo qadiimi ah oo boodh badan, dadkeeduna ay ku dhex milmeen beenin, iyo digniin kama dambays ah oo aan la dhegaysan. Maanta, u gudub doorka kuwa uu Alle u soo diray inay farriin u gudbiyaan dad madax adag. Sheeko diidmo ah, cod keliya oo iimaan ah, iyo dhammaad lagu shaabadeeyay amar ba'an. Yaa ka hadlaya tilmaamahan?
clues: Waxaa Alle noo diray magaalo dadkiisu ay ka leexdeen runta
Laba naga mid ah ayaa marka hore yimid, ka dibna mid saddexaad ayaa ku biiray si uu u xoojiyo hawlgalkeenna
Dadkii magaaladu way na diideen, iyagoo leh ma nihin dad iyaga la mid ah mooyee.
Naf keliya oo ka timid darafkii ugu fogaa magaalada ayaa orodday si ay dadka ugu sheegto inay na raacaan.
Waan la ballan qaadnay, laakiin way adkeeyeen qalbigooda oo way naga soo horjeesteen
Hal qaylo naxdin leh oo cirka ka timid, magaaladeenna oo dhan ayaa la aamusiyay

trial.answer: Dadka magaaladu way diideen oo beenaale ayay ku tilmaameen

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
